findings.title: PR body ends with Claude Code attribution, forbidden by global CLAUDE.md
findings.claim: The PR body's last line is "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]…", which violates the user's global CLAUDE.md rule forbidding that attribution in PR descriptions.

findings.title: New makeVectorType helper duplicates existing makeFloat32VectorType/makeDoubleVectorType
findings.claim: The new makeVectorType function sits next to existing makeFloat32VectorType and makeDoubleVectorType, which build the same VectorType{NativeType{TypeCustom, custom: …}} shape, suggesting possible duplicated code.

findings.title: Doc comment on TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType doesn't start with…
findings.claim: The doc comment for TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType starts with "VectorType, SubType and…" instead of the function name, unlike the other new tests.

findings.title: getApacheCassandraType(name) == TypeCustom used as unknown-type check, changing resolved…
findings.claim: Using getApacheCassandraType(name) == TypeCustom as the "unknown type" test and building NewCustomType(..., TypeCustom, name) inline changes the resolved TypeInfo for every caller of getCassandraLongType (frame.go:860, helpers.go:72), not just vector elements—the type now carries a custom name where it was previously empty, and nothing in the diff shows other callers were checked.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize returns 1 for zero-dimension inner vector instead of true minimum of 0
findings.claim: A zero-dimension inner vector's real minimum size is 0 bytes when fixed-size, but vectorElemMinSize returns 1, causing vector<vector<float,0>,N> with a short payload to be incorrectly rejected as "do not fit"; this is only reachable until dim < 1 rejection from #1093 lands, and the code comment doesn't note the floor is deliberately over-strict.

findings.title: Guard skips data == nil but errors on empty non-nil payload with Dimensions > 0
findings.claim: The guard only skips when data == nil, so an empty non-nil payload with Dimensions > 0 now errors even though this is described as intended behavior for short or empty payloads; noted as a behavior change worth a release note rather than a defect.

findings.title: Crash class not fully closed: negative vint length narrowing and nil SubType with…
findings.claim: A variable-length element's vint length narrowing to a negative value, and a nil SubType with Dimensions > 0, can still reach vectorFixedElemSize and Unmarshal on Scan's goroutine; the PR defers the first case to #1106, and the comment at marshal.go:995-997 covers only the Dimensions == 0 case.
